description: Looks up everyday foods (fruit, vegetables, grains, dairy, meat, fish, legumes, nuts, fats, sweets, drinks, dishes) in a built-in list of about 170, with Romanian dishes, and gives their calories and macros per 100 g and a usual portion. Names match in the chosen language, in English or in any other. Offline.

language.description: Language of food and recipe names; default en

query.description: e.g. "chicken breast", "măr", "sarmale"; empty lists the category

name: food_search
title: Search everyday foods
